sections.title: The Speed of AI Sync
sections.body: Networking in a high-performance compute environment is fundamentally different from standard enterprise IT. When training a model across multiple GPU nodes, the network becomes the backplane of the supercomputer. This FAQ addresses the specific architectural choices we made to ensure that Kenya AI Compute provides the 'Industrial Throughput' required for these tasks. We cover our diverse fiber paths to Mombasa, our internal RoCE v2 implementation, and our strategy for mitigating global network threats. If you are architecting a distributed training run and need to know about our MTU settings or specific BGP community strings, this section provides the raw data you need. Our goal is to provide a transparent network environment where your data moves at the speed of light, not the speed of regional gridlock. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
